newsitem.title: CHINA: Millennium raises stake in Grand Orient.
newsitem.headline: Millennium raises stake in Grand Orient.

text.p: Millennium Group Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to buy 33 million shares, or a 5.9 percent stake, in Grand Orient Holdings Ltd for HK$92.4 million, or HK$2.80 per share.
The acquisition will bring the Millennium Group's total stake in Grand Orient to 111.46 million shares, or about 20 percent of the issued share capital of the company.

"The directors consider the investment in Grand Orient to be a sound long term investment and therefore took advantage of the opportunity to increase its shareholding in Grand Orient," Millennium Group said.
Trading in Millennium and Grand Orient shares was suspended on Monday. Millennium had said it was preparing a statement about its stake in Grand Orient which would be released as soon as possible.
Millennium shares last traded at HK$3.35 and Grand Orient at HK$2.925.
